checks.description: The official CWI logo is present on every shipped visual asset. Brand rule: the logo ships on everything — no asset renders without the logo badge.

Every unit claim in copy-desk.json and units/*.json carries a non-empty source AND an observed_date (YYYY-MM-DD). Uncited claims are rejected by construction. The desk index mirrors the unit files exactly (ids, claim counts, claim bodies).
DEFAULT_CONFIG + optional config.json override flow works: a config.json with orgName/productName/colors overrides the CWI defaults and produces a branded build with no unreplaced tokens.

EQUIP / PULL / QUOTE steps are copy-paste operable: every URL referenced (desk index, a unit file, schema, card, page, hub device, contact) is live, and the QUOTE block is a valid citation-carrying snippet.
The proper noun COPY DESK appears untranslated in all 12 language blocks, and coverage is stated honestly as '12 languages' — never as universal coverage under any phrasing.

evidence.give-block-operability: give-block.md EQUIP/PULL/QUOTE reference copy-desk.json, a unit file, schema, item-card, page, press-kit hub, hp@cumulativeweb.com — all live per gate 2

evidence.truth-gate-conformance: all 22 claims across 4 units carry source + observed_date; desk index mirrors units/*.json (gate 3)
evidence.white-label-config: gate 4 builds a temp config.json override (orgName/productName/colors) through build.py and confirms the overrides land in index.html with no leftover tokens
